glossary.definition: Optical character recognition: turning images of text, such as scanned pages, into machine-readable text.
The embedded, selectable text in a digital PDF; scanned pages have none.
The sequence in which blocks of a page should be read, which matters for multi-column layouts.
Tokens repeated at the end of one chunk and the start of the next, so boundary sentences are not lost.
Searching small chunks for precision, then returning their larger parent section to the model.
The document title and section path prepended to a chunk before embedding.
Using a model to turn a vague or conversational question into a standalone search query.
Reordering a retrieved candidate list with a more precise model, keeping only the best few.
An answer whose every claim is supported by the provided sources.
Checking in code that each cited span exists in its source and supports the claim.
A pattern that grades retrieved passages and rewrites the query, switches source or abstains when they are weak.
An LLM-written report of a cluster of related entities in a GraphRAG index.
GraphRAG query mode that maps over community summaries and reduces them into one answer about the whole corpus.
A community detection method that groups densely connected nodes, used by GraphRAG at several levels.

symptomRouter.symptom: Scanned forms and tables come back as empty or jumbled text
symptomRouter.advice: Check for a text layer, OCR the scans in the right languages, keep tables as rows and drop headers.

symptomRouter.symptom: Answers miss the exception or condition in a clause
symptomRouter.advice: Chunk by clause with the section path prepended, and search small chunks but return the whole clause.

symptomRouter.symptom: Follow-up questions like “and the other one?” find nothing
symptomRouter.advice: Rewrite the follow-up into a standalone query, and add multi-query or HyDE if wording varies.

symptomRouter.symptom: The right passage is retrieved but ranked 15th
symptomRouter.advice: Retrieve 50 to 100 candidates and re-rank them with a cross-encoder, multilingual for Hinglish.

symptomRouter.symptom: Staff cannot tell whether an answer is true or current
symptomRouter.advice: Answer only from sources, cite each sentence, verify citations and filter superseded versions.

symptomRouter.symptom: Questions hide filters or need a second attempt
symptomRouter.advice: Let an agent plan filters, grade what it retrieves and rewrite or say “not found”.

symptomRouter.symptom: Questions about themes across all documents, or multi-hop joins, get poor answers
symptomRouter.advice: GraphRAG: extract a graph, summarise communities, and route global or multi-hop questions to it.
